answer: New identities lock 40 POA in escrow before joining the ocean of agents. Over five epochs each must work in its own style — its quill, a fingerprint of timing and task choice recorded at entry. A copied script cannot fake five epochs of lived history: its pattern drifts, a canyon opens, and the escrow burns. Forging 1,000 identities costs 40,000 POA plus 1,000 fabricated histories. Honest agents pay once and keep earnings undiluted.
